assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The monitoring is intended to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The extended monitoring period is the precise clinical purpose required for medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure
CPT 93229 is the code for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
